reasons: carryover chapters do not have a fixed daily actual total
scarcity_certificate.scope: all legal constant-total C3 actions under verified zero-rain and ET0 support; not daily full-ET need, terminal value, or C4--6

regional_model.unit: whole midseason-rice area within each outlet service range
regional_model.zero_action: no irrigation today; stored water, ET and yield history continue evolving

env_model_config.root_available_water_definition: S=Z*(theta_fc-theta_wp); Z in mm; excludes surface ponding; research effective capacity, not measured rooting depth
env_model_config.budget_provenance: reduced-case explicit budget; default 4_000_000 m3 primary high-yield research budget; fixed841.2ha
env_model_config.daily_supply_limit_identity: seasonal budget as mathematical upper bound; ideal availability, not engineering capacity

weather_contract.conditioning: date-only filtered seasonal donors; independent of state, action and previous wet/dry class
weather_contract.pair_sampling: uniform filtered training donor; replace rain by zero and retain donor ET0 exactly
weather_contract.historical_replay: none; controlled research sequence, not historical replay
weather_contract.fallback: initial date only: if exact month/day has no eligible donor, use its +/-15-day training window; reject empty support
weather_contract.forecast: exact filtered seasonal donor mean, zero rain, no RNG draw or realized future lookup
weather_contract.initial_previous_weather: eligible previous-month/day training donor; documented seasonal fallback only if empty
weather_contract.scope: one pair shared by all regions; no local perturbations
weather_contract.settings_status: controlled no-rain, high-evaporative-demand research scenario; not observed local drought
weather_contract.et0_selection: retain original ET0 >= threshold; no clipping, scaling or replacement
weather_contract.year_role: calendar metadata only; no evaluation-year weather is sampled

information_assumptions.water_and_et_reports: current ideal model reports in all four chapters; not a claim of perfect daily field measurements
information_assumptions.initial_state: known research initial field capacity theta=.39, zero ponded water; not measured initial conditions
information_assumptions.weather: policy receives shared previous-day observed rain and ET0; historical conditional mean is explicit public-display information only
information_assumptions.calendar_budget_and_terminal_evaluation: current and public in every chapter
information_assumptions.chapter6_problem: joint C90 and area-weighted relative yield; no per-unit hard guarantee
information_assumptions.et_policy_compression: completed-stage Jensen product per region, active-stage actual ET per region and one shared active-stage fully supplied ET; all at received report date, complete ledgers retained for audit

env_model_config.case_status: reduced research subset; not a complete published irrigation district

objective_spec.dual_value_usage: use [C,JA]; J is auxiliary only; do not mix joint scalar reward twice

env_model_config.policy_info: empty until terminal; audit/display APIs are separate
env_model_config.forcing_visibility: private evaluation input; only previous realised pair enters observation

implementation.value_heads: independent sigmoid-C and unbounded-JA state-only models
implementation.preference: last global input; algorithm setting fixed for each physical episode
implementation.replay: after32 episodes, current4 plus immediately previous4 with original preferences
implementation.actor_advantage: raw-unit lambda*A_C+(1-lambda)*A_JA then one joint scalar normalization
implementation.warmup: first32 episodes still optimize requested objective; current8, clip.2
implementation.postwarm: current4+previous4, generalized clip .2/1.5; frozen Vtrace targets
implementation.TV_controller: one final measured TV transition per postwarm outer update
implementation.theoretical_scope: finite-horizon clipped-rho adaptation; no unbiasedness, monotonicity or true-front theorem

endpoint_policy: one predeclared endpoint within phase; no bestDEV/TEST checkpoint selection; no optimizer/replay snapshot
